summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential launch data, find where the system's 'all ok' plan hides real shortfalls, and build an agent product that detects, explains with sourced evidence, and acts (supplier emails, voice/push alerts) on new data drops.
summary.outcome: Found the key launch risks (art book overbooking, failed statue lot, game card airline offload, sleeve revision conflict, false magnet alarm), produced briefing docs/pages and an interview doc, built a portal poller/alert-agent and rebased it onto Akshat's new inbox (PR #5 into main, 164 tests passing), and built local-OCR evidence anchoring plus a redesigned evidence panel; the last commits are unpushed.

repo: Portal API has only list files, get file and archive.zip; no webhooks. Files change without notice and can be replaced under the same name, so polling and comparing SHA-256 checksums is the intended approach.

State lives in data/state JSON files plus SQLite; actions.json is Akshat's list format, and the older alert-agent code wrongly treated it as a dict, which risked wiping history. State dir env var is ASK_STATE_DIR (old ASK_SOONY_STATE_DIR is replaced), and ASK_DATA_DIR is used by tests.

Card builder dispatch/decisions/cards.py flattens evidence to plain strings, losing file/page references, so cards show snippets with nothing to click. It is owned by the verifier pipeline (Farhan/Akshat).
Confidential portal data, scans, notes and .env live in the gitignored data/ folder; only .env.example is committed.

Anchoring indexes ~320 portal files in ~36s (text PDFs by word position, tesseract OCR for scans/images, table rows) and is cached; tesseract was added to the Dockerfile and without it scans are simply not indexed.
Entire checkpoints are now stored as per-checkpoint refs (refs/entire/checkpoints/<xx>/<id>), not the old entire/checkpoints/v1 branch; Entire skips checkpoints when no repo files changed.

code.finding: New anchoring module: normalizes numbers/IDs (56.000 = 56,000 = 56000), matches evidence to PDF words, OCR boxes and table rows, ranks candidates, and prefers source docs over tables.
Public-path list includes /favicon.svg so the login page can load the icon; a stray uncommitted revert from another session was discarded.
Shared send path used by both the Approve button and voice 'yes'; only sends to emails from known supplier profiles, otherwise just records the decision.

workflow: Two Claude sessions working in the same checkout interleaved commits and left uncommitted changes; separate worktrees would avoid this.
GitHub 'ready to merge' only means no textual conflicts; it did not reveal semantic conflicts (two actions.json formats, two card worlds, missing voice UI) after a hand merge into another branch.
Use a subagent for bulk cross-checks (200 order confirmations vs SAP, 59 scans), and verify UI changes via headless Chrome screenshots.
Checking teammates' branches and PROGRESS.md before building avoided duplicate work; tell owners before touching shared files like DecisionCard.tsx.
